name: webex
description: Guided setup and troubleshooting for Cisco's hosted Webex MCP servers.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and troubleshoot the Webex MCP servers
interface.longDescription: Walks you through connecting to Cisco's hosted Webex MCP servers: choosing which servers to connect, which scopes to grant, verifying the OAuth callback port is bindable, registering the Integration with the right redirect URI, and diagnosing invalid_scope, redirect and 403 failures.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me set up the Webex MCP servers.
